name: toreador
description: Ask for a crypto payment, check whether it was paid, and show a direct QR code, from Claude. Installs the official Toreador MCP server and three guided skills. Non-custodial: funds go from the payer's wallet to yours; no tool can move funds or change a wallet.

toreador_api_key.title: Toreador API key
toreador_api_key.description: From your Toreador dashboard, API section. A key starting with tor_test_ works on test networks, outside your quota; a key starting with tor_live_ creates real payment requests.
